## Data source

The dialogue analysis uses transcript lines from the [`southparkr` R package](https://github.com/pdrhlik/southparkr), covering *South Park* seasons 1-21 (1997-2017). The transcripts identify the speaking character and episode; the analysis counts those lines to compare character and group dialogue. Dialogue counts describe who speaks, not screen time or story importance.
